scopes.name: v0.2.0
scopes.goal: Architecture consolidation: retire the Outbox dispatch path in favour of core::Dispatcher, refactor the event model, mechanically restructure src/, and begin the memory-safety plan
features: Dispatcher port: replace dispatch::Outbox with core::Dispatcher owned by App; delete Outbox class and dispatch::Outbox fields
Event model refactor: unified DOM-like Lua event object (name/type/target/payload, preventDefault, stopPropagation)
Cleaner project structure (v0.2.0 mechanical phase): group flat src/*.cpp into modules, resolve src/packages/ vs root packages/ name collision
Memory safety plan part 1: sol3 table/function lifetime guards, App* lifetime guards in bridge/dispatch callbacks
Carryover from v0.1.1: platform dialog error recovery (try/catch around GTK/Win32 native calls)
Carryover from v0.1.1: finish smart-pointer migration of remaining raw-new sites in window/context/commands/bridge/main_runtime/store/app
CI: add TSAN sanitizer job alongside existing ASAN matrix
Configurable queue capacity on MessageQueue (supersedes outbox-capacity carryover if Outbox is retired first)

scopes.name: v0.1.1
scopes.goal: Hardening, memory safety, test coverage, and code quality improvements before v0.2 features
features: Smart pointer migration (unique_ptr for all owned resources)
CI: Add ASAN + TSAN sanitizer jobs
Test coverage for window, webview_transport, hotreload, context, argparse
Fix error swallowing in Lua-bound functions
Move remaining inline Lua registrations into modules
IWYU cleanup (remove iostream from headers, forward-declare where possible)
Platform dialog error recovery (try/catch around native calls)
Audit and fix string handling patterns
